info.title: Cancel Inbound Order
info.description:
This API is used to cancel an inbound order prior to warehouse arrival, preventing further processing and updating the order status.
**If cancelling an inbound order that is part of a D2FC inbound plan, please make sure to cancel all orders under the inbound plan, otherwise non-compliance fees may be charged.**
